name: context-health-bar
description: Battery-style context health bar below the prompt, color-coded red to green, with 5h/7d usage-window reset countdowns

maxTokens.title: Fallback Window (tokens)
maxTokens.description: Context window size used until the model's real window is known (9 bars total, 3 per color)

yellowPercent.title: Yellow Percent
yellowPercent.description: Percent of the context window at which the bar shows the yellow tip " → considere /passagem". Overridden by /context-config yellow <n>

redPercent.title: Red Percent
redPercent.description: Percent of the context window at which the bar shows the red tip " → /passagem e /clear" (replaces the yellow tip). Overridden by /context-config red <n>
